blocks.content: Quiz: What happens when enabled is set to false on a useQuery call?
Tap an option below to answer:
The query runs once and then stops
The query doesn't run at all when enabled is false.
The query doesn't run at all when enabled is false.
No error is thrown. The query just sits idle.
No error is thrown. The query just sits idle.
The query doesn't run until enabled becomes true
Correct. React Query watches the enabled value and fires the query the moment it becomes true.
Correct. React Query watches the enabled value and fires the query the moment it becomes true.
The query runs but ignores the result
The query doesn't run at all. It's completely paused.
The query doesn't run at all. It's completely paused.
